title: Hit a pothole? What to check afterwards
summary: A hard knock can damage tyres, wheels and suspension. These are the signs to look out for in the days after.
author: The Kestrel Garage team

body.p: Most pothole knocks cause no lasting harm, but a heavy one can bend a wheel or upset the alignment.

ul: A bulge or cut in the tyre sidewall.
The steering wheel sitting off centre on a straight road.
A new knock or rattle over bumps.
The car pulling to one side.

body.p: If you notice any of these, call the garage to arrange a check.
